name: HiBob
summary: HiBob sells Bob, an HR platform whose core module holds structured employee records, time off policies and people analytics dashboards. Its pricing page shows no prices and sends buyers to a demo form, so the cost is quote only.

facts.text: The time and attendance page says time off policies can be set by location, department or employee group, and covers holidays, sick days and PTO.
The analytics page lists configurable HR dashboard views with role-based data access.
The home page shows SOC 2 and ISO 27001 badge images but states neither certification in text.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: The pricing page offers only a demo request form

hiddenCosts: No plan names, prices or minimums are published.
